master:PROVINCE.md:20:**Round-23 refinement (C3 lane-tool inventory; no new write surface, no cross-domain bleed):** the lane's own analysis instruments are named here so the province accounts for every tracked tool it runs. `tools/mado-action-plan.py` reads the JSON bytes of a caller-supplied declared action plan and a JSON safety policy (regular files only; symlinks, FIFOs and devices are refused), prints one `MADO_PLAN:` line and one JSON verdict, writes no host state (its `--selftest` writes only ephemeral fixtures inside a private temporary directory and runs a copy of itself as a child process), and is therefore a lane safety gate over declared plans rather than a new desktop surface. `tools/mado-tripwire.py` reads the `.jsonl` bytes of OMP session transcripts it is pointed at, treating assistant command text as data it never executes, prints one `MADO_TRIPWIRE:` or `MADO_TRIPWIRE_FROZEN:` line and one JSON verdict, writes no file at all (its `--selftest` only re-invokes itself), and is therefore a lane evidence instrument over issued-command text rather than a new desktop surface. `tools/mado-assessment.py` reads an assessment bundle and the population and expectation files it names under `--root` (bounded, symlink- and traversal-refused), prints one JSON verdict object, writes no file at all (its `--selftest` only re-invokes itself), and is therefore a lane integrity gate over the lane's own paperwork rather than a new desktop surface. `tools/mado-evidence-audit.py` reads an evidence bundle, the snapshot it names and the inventoried files under `--root` whose digest and size it compares, prints one JSON verdict object, writes no file at all (its `--selftest` only re-invokes itself), and is therefore a lane evidence gate over artifact arithmetic rather than a new desktop surface. OUT (report, never absorb): these instruments own no config tree and no host state; the tripwire's transcript bytes are read as data and its findings are lane-local evidence about issued commands, never a fleet-wide or sibling-lane conduct verdict (transcript observation stays with mori); package state stays with tsukuroi; secret-shaped values stay with kagi (the tripwire redacts secret-shaped substrings from the command text it prints instead of reporting their content); and the reusable mutation-testing method stays with tameshi (`tools/mado-verify.sh` consumes tameshi's `mutate-and-run.sh` read-only and prints its revision as provenance, never patching it and never gating it).

master:PROVINCE.md:124:**Round-55 refinement (append-only; one read-only tool, four record instruments, one knowledge entry and one errata correction; no new write surface):** `tools/mado-kbdopts.py` is a read-only join. It reads only the files its caller names: each `--config` path (Hyprland config text, regular files, 1 MiB cap) and at most one `--getoption` path (a captured `hyprctl getoption -j` reply). From these it computes the effective per-keyboard `input:repeat_rate`, `input:repeat_delay` and `input:numlock_by_default` values under the hyprlang 0.6.8 subset it models, and compares the global values with the live reply. Constructs it refuses are counted `unsupported` and ignored, never guessed; a `source =` line is skipped without a count and its file is not followed, and the tool's docstring lists the known divergences from Hyprland's own parser (round-55 wave-2 source review). It starts no process, opens no socket and writes nothing; the operator captures the `getoption` reply with the read verb and applies no change. The round's record instruments are `quality/counters/c1-r55-kbd-entry.py` (PRED-C1-r55, the entry's counter), `quality/counters/c3-r55-p19.py` (PRED-C3-r55, the errata correction counter), `quality/check-r55-controls.py` (the independent harness that builds the frozen negative controls in scratch git repositories and runs the counters and the C2 fixtures as child processes under its `--work` directory) and `quality/check-freeze-order.py` (the freeze-order gate delivered as the M54-2/M54-4 mistake fix; its input contract is not stated in the frozen registration and is unverified until it lands). The counters and harness write only under `--work`; none touches a config plane, the compositor, a socket or a host service. Keypress delivery, client-side repeat and the seat's numlock state are outside every instrument.
